cards.name: Blend Options...
cards.summary: Opens the Blend Options dialog, which sets how a blend fills the gap between its key objects: the spacing (Smooth Color, Specified Steps or Specified Distance) and the orientation of the in-between objects (aligned to the page or to the spine path). With a blend selected the change applies to it; with no blend selected it sets the defaults for the next blends (the harvest found it enabled even with no document).
use_for: setting an exact number of steps for a stepped colour or shape transition in a poster or logo
making smooth colour blends for 3D-looking lettering or ribbons
orienting blended objects along a curved spine for patterns and borders
avoid: huge step counts on complex objects: files get heavy and slow; use fewer steps or a gradient
plain two-colour fades: a gradient fill is lighter and easier to edit
cards.how: Spacing: Smooth Color lets Illustrator pick enough steps for a seamless colour transition; Specified Steps sets the number of in-between objects; Specified Distance sets the gap between them. Orientation: Align to Page keeps the steps upright, Align to Path turns them along the spine. Tick Preview to see a selected blend update.
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Path Blend Options") opens the dialog only (id paired by Keyboard Shortcuts dialog alignment, not confirmed by execution). No object-model call for blend spacing or orientation is known; blends appear to scripts as PluginItem objects (unverified).
